body:
## Goal
Implement a stacked follow-up to PR #268 that allows `track-only` runs to upload debug session bundles only when `session_bundle_mode: always`, while keeping restore/download disabled for `track-only`.

## Context
PR #268 makes `track-only` session policy one-shot to avoid stale persistent ACP context while still tracking thread state. A follow-up request asks to split the current single session bundle gate into direction-specific decisions so restore/download and backup/upload can behave differently.

Current helper `shouldUseSessionBundles(mode, policy)` gates restore/download, backup/upload preparation, and artifact registration. The requested semantics are:

- `never`: restore false, backup false
- `auto + track-only`: restore false, backup false
- `always + track-only`: restore false, backup true
- resume policies: restore true and backup true for `auto` and `always`

Important safety detail: uploaded `track-only` bundles must not become restorable continuity material. Either avoid registering them as restorable, or register them with explicit non-restorable/debug-only metadata and make restore ignore them.

## Suggested Implementation
Replace the single bundle decision helper with direction-specific helpers such as:

- `shouldRestoreSessionBundles(mode, policy)`
- `shouldBackupSessionBundles(mode, policy)`

Keep the existing workflow shape unchanged because restore and upload/register already run in separate phases in `.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml`.

Relevant code paths:

- `.agent/src/session-bundle.ts`
- `.agent/src/cli/session-restore.ts`
- `.agent/src/cli/session-backup.ts`
- `.agent/src/cli/session-register.ts`
- `.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml`

## Acceptance Criteria
- `track-only` never downloads or restores session bundles.
- `track-only` with `session_bundle_mode: always` prepares and uploads a debug bundle.
- `track-only` with `session_bundle_mode: auto` does not prepare/upload bundles, avoiding default artifact churn.
- Resume-capable policies continue to restore and back up bundles for `auto` and `always` modes.
- Uploaded `track-only` bundles are explicitly non-restorable or are not registered as restorable continuity state.
- Tests cover the direction-specific helper semantics and the key `track-only` restore/upload invariants.
- This should be implemented as a stacked PR on top of PR #268.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/268

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-272/codex-26007926364`
- Pull request: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/274

Implemented upload-only debug session bundles for `track-only` runs when `session_bundle_mode: always`, while keeping restore/download disabled and marking those uploaded artifacts with a non-restorable backend so future resume/fork paths ignore them. Also added transient exec sessions for debug capture, updated docs, and verified with `npm run build`, focused node tests, and `git diff --check`.

title: Add upload-only track-only session bundles
